BeforeHandDraw.issue: This card SHARES card/bolas's return-to-hand helper, and the two C# implementations are byte-identical (ThrummingHatchet.cs:33-43 vs Bolas.cs:39-49), so the finding transfers verbatim and carries the same verdict (rule 3). The trigger condition and the pre-draw slot are faithful: `History.CardPlaysFinished.Any(e => e.HappenedLastPlayerTurn(Owner) && e.CardPlay.Card == this)` == the sim's `e.card is card and e.turn == combat.turn - 1` over `CardPlayedEntry`. THE PILE SEARCH IS NOT: C# tests only `pile == null || pile.Type != PileType.Hand` and then calls `CardPileCmd.Add(this, PileType.Hand)`, which moves the card to hand from WHEREVER it is -- including the EXHAUST pile -- while the sim's helper searches only `(player.draw_pile, player.discard_pile)` (colorless_attacks.py:532-535) and silently gives up otherwise. Observable: play Thrumming Hatchet, then exhaust it -- next turn the game returns it to hand and the sim does not. LIVE: card/brand and card/burning_pact are ported hand-exhausters that pass a NULL filter, and card/second_wind and card/fiend_fire exhaust the hand wholesale.
